The physics — one ladder, three curves, one press
Move 2 — the counter, a row closes its own gap
Move 6 — the departure on the lock screen

annotations.text: Read the cover first, then the Physics sheet: the ladder, the three curves, the press, and the table of what moves when. Page 2 holds the surfaces, one move each. Move 5, the press, has no surface of its own; it is on the Physics sheet.

Blue Mantis Divers, Thursday August 27, 2026, 6:41 AM at the counter and 6:40 on the home; Yara Halabi's Thursday September 3 on the thread. Every name is invented. Reef in Geist on the staff boards; the demo shop's green and Bricolage Grotesque on the diver's.
The dashed line and the finger ring on the sheet's second frame are the canvas's own marks. Nothing like them ships.
H-69 b is this board's whole existence: declined, the thread stays as it ships and this board renders nothing.

No board on this canvas is a manifest, a roll call, a cert check, a waiver or a payment. Whether the roll and the slide reach the roll call at all is H-69 c; the head count never rolls under any answer.
